name: Concurrent Enrollment on Popular Course Launch
environment: Production during a scheduled course launch event with high anticipated demand
stimulus: 4,000 users simultaneously attempt to enroll in a newly released course within the first 5 minutes of its availability
response: The system auto-scales the EnrollmentService and PaymentService independently, processes all enrollment requests without degradation, and confirms or rejects each enrollment within 3 seconds

name: Last Seat Reservation Race Condition
environment: Production under high concurrency during a limited-seat course enrollment window
stimulus: 200 users simultaneously attempt to enroll in a course with exactly 10 seats remaining
response: The system prevents over-enrollment by handling seat reservation atomically via the enrollment saga; exactly 10 enrollments succeed and all others receive a clear seats-unavailable response with no inconsistent state

name: Video Content Delivery Under Peak Load
environment: Production during a live course session with all enrolled students watching simultaneously
stimulus: 1,000 enrolled students concurrently request the same lecture video stream
response: The system serves video content to 95% of requests within 2 seconds by leveraging the caching layer; MediaService load does not impact EnrollmentService or PaymentService response times

name: Add New Content Type Without Modifying Enrollment
environment: CI/CD pipeline during a scheduled feature release
stimulus: The platform adds support for a new content type (live interactive sessions) requiring its own scheduling, capacity management, and access control logic
response: The new content type is implemented as an isolated new service and deployed without modifying EnrollmentService, PaymentService, or CourseService; existing enrollments and content types continue to function correctly; deployment completes within 2 days

name: Student Data Access Audit for Compliance Request
environment: Production under a regulatory compliance audit or GDPR data access request
stimulus: A compliance officer requests a complete, tamper-evident log of all access to a specific student's personal data, quiz submissions, and payment records over the past 12 months
response: All actions are authenticated and authorized via the API Gateway and AuthService; the AuditService returns a complete, immutable log covering all requested events within the retention window; unauthorized access attempts are logged and rejected with a 401 response
